description:
Returns historical uptime events, incidents, and outages for a specific monitor ID.

Useful for checking the long-term reliability of a specific website or server over time.

id.description:
Purpose: The unique ID of the monitor.

Accepted values: Integer ID.

limit.description:
Purpose: Maximum number of historical records to return.

Accepted values: Integer between 1 and 100.

name: get_monitor_history
